text:
kyle: Need a quick merge slot for PR #22311 — waiting on mac e2e and linux-ci is green but queue is slow. Can we hold until the canary window tonight? cc @sana @ben

sana: @kyle how big is the rebase? full window or just a quick conflict resolve?

kyle: just a small conflict in db migration. `git rebase origin/main` + `yarn test:ci` should do it. estimate 10-15m if CI runs promptly.

ben: CI queue is quite backed up after the infra jobs earlier. ETA for mac matrix is ~45m. If you can split the migration into a tiny PR we might land faster.

kyle: splitting is messy for this change, unfortunately. Is there a spare slot we can borrow — maybe swap with a non-critical canary?

emily: we have one canary slot at 23:00 UTC but perf-team owns it. We could nudge perf to 00:30 if they're ok.

sana: @perf-team any objections to moving perf to 00:30?

perf-team: (bot) We can shift the perf slot by 30m, but we need a confirmation by 21:30 UTC to rebook infra.

kyle: confirming now. I'll rebase and trigger CI, will monitor logs. Thanks :pray:

ops-bot: merge-queue status: mac-matrix length 12, avg wait 37m. Reserved canary slot at 23:00 UTC held by perf-team.

ben: If you rebase and kick CI now we can try to prioritize with a label like `ci:high-priority`. @ops can you help unblock prioritization?

ops: sure — we'll allow one priority bump. Adding `ci:high-priority` to PR #22311. Please avoid repeated retries.

kyle: label added and CI triggered. watching logs and will ping when mac result is in.

emily: noted. If mac passes and canary slot is still free, ops — please hold merge until the canary run completes for safety.

ops: Roger. Holding auto-merge until canary gating completes. :white_check_mark:

kyle: mac passed! last check: canary still go? pinging @sana @emily

sana: saw mac pass. I can give review + approval after canary result. If anything flakes we'll rollback canary.

emily: approved for canary gating. :thumbsup:

kyle: rolled to canary at 23:02 UTC. will update thread when canary finishes.
